title: Restriction coefficients on a system of open subspaces
statement: Let I be a preordered set, V_i an antitone family of opens of a topological space T, E a subset of every V_i, and A an abelian sheaf on T. Define F_i as the constructed inverse image of A to V_i. Transpose the unit-preserving inverse-image composition isomorphism to define the transition f-maps. These obey the identity and composition laws on sections. Their inverse images to E identify with the constant diagram of A restricted to E via the inverse composition isomorphisms, and this identification obeys the sectionwise unit compatibility required for a spectral-limit coefficient presentation.

proof.text: Use a reducible abbreviation of the subtype-val inclusion. Construct inclusions, stage inverse images, transition f-maps and the constant coefficient diagram explicitly using the inverse-image adjunction and its uniquely unit-preserving composition isomorphism. No theorem with an arbitrary existence witness supplies data.

The leftAdjointUniq unit identity identifies both composite transition units with the ambient inclusion unit. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection gives identity and composition of transitions. The same cancellation after postcomposition with the composition isomorphism proves coefficient compatibility. Evaluate the resulting sheaf morphism equalities on sections.
The constant coefficient functor exists by the ordinary constant-diagram construction; it uses no existence theorem to select data.
